about_the_game:
In a fantasy continent torn apart by war, the rise and fall of royal power depend on choices made between day and night —— Lord of the Crowns integrates the in-depth management of city-building with the real-time gameplay of tower defense strategy. As a lord, you will construct cities and expand territories by day, and defend against enemies to survive by night. From a temporary camp to an iron dynasty, every decision will be inscribed into the kingdom's legend.

Game Features

  • Multi-dimensional strategic combination of Heroes + Technology + Units, ensuring distinct gameplay in each match.

  • Immersive day-night cycle mechanism, enabling seamless switching between the "sense of construction achievement" and "combat tension".

  • Global overview + countdown warning for precise and efficient decisions, eliminating ineffective operations.

  • Growth line from camp to dynasty, witnessing the complete epic of the kingdom's rise.

Initial Choice: Heroes Define Tactical Direction

Before entering the game, choose a hero that fits your strategy —— directly setting the core gameplay direction for the entire match. Whether you are a steady defensive player or an aggressive fast-attack expander, it's all up to you!

Technology Empowerment: Unlock Soldiers' Combat Limits

Technology is the key to defeating enemies! Choose from dozens of tactical technologies: "Swift Stride" allows soldiers to maneuver flexibly on the battlefield, "Armor-Piercing Blade" tears through the enemy's heavy armor defenses, and "Fortress Reinforcement" turns city walls into impenetrable barriers. Precisely matching technology with units can exponentially enhance troop combat effectiveness, laying a solid foundation for resisting waves of powerful enemy invasions.

Infrastructure Layout: Terrain-Adapted Offense and Defense

Site selection, planning, and placement —— every step is crucial to the kingdom's survival! Farms and sawmills need to be close to resource points to ensure output, barracks must rely on location to seize tactical opportunities, and city walls are the top priority for early defense. Reasonably planning the direction of city walls can not only block enemy sneak attacks but also divide the battlefield to form a natural defense line. Through the global building overview panel, optimize the layout in real time to achieve seamless connection between production and defense.

Nighttime Defense: Pre-Battle Deployment Decides Victory

When the territory's development is on track, raids by dark forces will arrive as scheduled! Rely on the enemy attack countdown system to deploy troops in advance, and use carefully planned tactics and technology-boosted units to defend every inch of the territory. Surviving the night is victory!

Territory Tour: Freeze Your Exclusive Royal Glory

After the war subsides, slow down and admire the kingdom you built with your own hands —— from the initial temporary camp to the now densely packed city-states and impregnable defense lines, every building embodies your strategy and efforts. Activate the UI-free photo mode to freeze the exclusive glory moment of your lordship!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: win7/win10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 or AMD FX8320
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 or AMD Radeon R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: win7/win10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: In "Kingdom Monarch", you are a monarch and can build the kingdom of your dreams! You need to build city walls, assign jobs to villagers, recruit soldiers, repel hordes of monsters at night, and expand your village during the day.
supported_languages: Simplified Chinese, English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Turkish, Japanese, Polish, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Korean
